reviewed: Pruning enumerates dialable keys plus lifecycle-only keys exactly once; active connected/dialing/closing peers stay outside inactive count. Bootnodes/pending requests retain protection within count exactly as prior policy.
Excess is calculated before protected-inactive filtering, so nonprotected removals bring total inactive union toward500 without overriding protected peers when they alone exceed the cap.

Existing preference/useful-success/status-success/PeerId ascending eviction order remains unchanged. Eviction removes dialable, observed, lifecycle, per-connection/support/failure/success state and per-peer inbound buckets; no pending request is eligible. Periodic expiry remains separate.

Live observations and saved selection share the same IP+TCP/QUIC endpoint construction and configured-family filter, including existing mapped-IPv6 rejection. Discovery UDP alone does not establish RPC eligibility.

selected_known_peers preserves relevant-fork/OP-stack filtering, known-no-Status exclusion, remembered metadata and dial counters, descending identical peer_priority and ascending serialized-ENR tie breaker, then256 cap.

Priority is derived once from already decoded routing-table ENRs. Installed enr parser verifies signatures, so removing comparator reparse avoids redundant work without removing a trust-boundary check. No measured speed claim.

Cache selection does not require configured-family UDP when compatible RPC exists: this matches existing startup path, which loads usable RPC addresses even when discovery endpoint cannot be seeded. last_persisted comparison and persistence behavior remain unchanged.
Read new mixed-union/dedup, priority/protection, repeated-prune, live-family and saved-cache ordering/limit controls; no tests executed by reviewer.

freshness_followup.observation: An older stored compatible address may remain after an ineligible observed ENR because helper returnsNone without deleting. Family filtering extends the already existing no-RPC-address case.
freshness_followup.evidence: Pinned discv5 service.discovered emits Discovered before routing-table seq comparisons; network observes events/query results/table snapshots without storing ENRseq in address map.
freshness_followup.implication: Cannot claim freshness, and blind delete-on-None can let older advertisements erase newer usable addresses. Sequence-authoritative replacement/removal needs a scoped design and bounded newer/older/reordered-event controls.
freshness_followup.current_clearance: No additional current family-eligibility/ranking/retention blocker; current stored address family remains configured. Latest ENR endpoint freshness is not established.

limits: Read-only source/dependency review; no Cargo, tests, benchmark, remote/live operations, edits or commits.
Root owns gates and final snapshot reconciliation.
Periodic retention is not an instantaneous hard memory bound; protected peers may exceed500.
Gossip/message IDs, cache-file crash durability/malformed-file handling and sequence freshness are not closed.

scope: Temporary fixtures and scripted objects only; no live discovery, swarm polling, peers or user data.
Existing retention cap, priority policy and protected states retained.
Sequence-aware ENR freshness, aggregate response memory, gossip message-ID conformance and peer-cache durability remain separate recorded follow-ups.
